bucket_reason: Stuck after the chain-law stage: the chain law fits, but the steady state ends at k = 650,686 (walls merge, D and F meet double walls), so the planned invariant is false; confidence low.
question: W4-6 and its twin (line 612) have no steady state past 1e11 (walls merge and the far walls turn irregular): keep both parked, fund one merge-tolerant closed-language search, or only watch for a misaligned tape?

options.label: Keep both lines parked
options.consequence: No compute. Both stay STUCK with the exact model, the chain law, the fast simulator (scripts/hyb.c) and the event list kept for a later multi-level-counter method.

options.label: One ~2 h merge-tolerant language search
options.consequence: Native search for a wall-level closed language (capped gap values, wall status, phase) that contains merges and right-end visits in every phase and excludes A at a double wall and misaligned tapes; a hit is the invariant. Low odds: the far walls are irregular and history-dependent.

options.label: Only watch the long run
options.consequence: Several hours of one core: give scripts/hyb.c a leaner TM fallback and run on from 2^28 to 2^30 or beyond (about 2e18 steps), reporting whether A ever meets a double wall or the tape misaligns (the only route to a halt seen so far). No proof value either way.

rationale: Chain law exact but with 2^q irregular masks per level; the masks of levels >= 5 change at each merge.
To 2^26: D at a double wall 6x, F 1x, right end in phase D 5x; the planned invariant (ii)/(iii) is false.
A safe invariant must cover an irregular far region; K(n; a) alone is not closed (random words misalign).

evidence.text: Far run to 2^25: the left walls stay put, the right part jumps at each merge.
Non-C zero gaps after start-up: R10 at k = 650,686 ... 61,730,238 (6x), R12 at 44,953,023; A 0x; none new and no halt to 2^28.
Chain law l = t1(((k^c)>>(2q+1)) ^ m_q[s]): 0 conflicts to 1e11 and at k ~ 2^24; joint fit conflicts at levels 5..9.
Random K(n; a): R13 misaligns or leaves the rule set in 275 of 1,897 cases; 0 halts in 1e6 one-cycle runs.

effort_if_yes: park: none; merge_lang: ~2 h agent time, light native compute; watch: a small simulator change, then hours of one core.
